title: [Derelict Queen, Audience Room]
description: The thin-planked walls are covered from floor to ceiling with chests and coffers crafted from numerous woods and metals, the locked containers spaced out between carved marble statues of sea kobolds.  Rich, well-brushed furs line a trio of steps leading up to a lacquered silk-cushioned throne, the seat haloed by bladed weapons entangled in knotted lengths of rope.  Several barrels and chairs are scattered at the center of the room, each one decorated in the shredded lengths of patchwork flags.
